[quote=technokratisches_kaiserreich;59800143][b]Ich bin hierher gekommen, um den Kriegszustand zwischen dem Kaiserreich und seinen Feinden zu verkünden.[/b]

[i]I have come here to declare a state of war between the Kaiserreich and her enemies.
- In the Hohenrat des Reiches(June 24th)[/i]

[spoiler=[b]Ansprache vor dem Hohenrat des Reiches[/b]]

On the morning of June 24th, the Kaiser called a special session of the Hohenrat des Reiches to discuss a matter of extreme importance to the State. A war had broken out between Enkia, Nestor-Sikirsk and their Sikirskian backers right on the doorstep of the Kaiserreich, on the soil of Elseyr itself. The war in the south against the Bobians was progressing smoothly with J-16s already en route towards Bobian positions and hypersonic missiles already being deployed against their fleets. 

The members of the ruling party, the Hochdeutsche Nationale Partei began to fill the seats of the assembly room. Behind them draped the black, red and white flags of the Kaiserreich and in front the podium, where the Kaiser waited. As a few stragglers settled into their seats, the Kaiser would ascend to the podium to raucous applause from the assembly. 

My fellow countrymen, 

I have come here to declare an official state of war between Nestor-Sikirsk, their allies and the Kaiserreich. We have witnessed in the north an act of aggression by the Nestor-Sikirskian government against Enkia. The Nestor-Sikirskian government is an extension of Sikirsk into the heartland of Elseyr, a colony established by foreigners. 

For now we have had no qualms with the Sikirskians. However, their act of aggression makes their imperialist and expansionist objectives all too clear. Now a band of foreign nations attempt to implant themselves into Elseyran affairs as well, a group of foreign barbarians encroaching upon the sovereignty of Elseyr. 

The Kaiserreich will not stand for this. 

This morning I have ordered the Central Military Commission to begin war preparations against the Nestor-Sikirskian governments and their allies to aid the Enkians in their struggle. God bless the Kaiserreich and God be with us all.[/spoiler]

[spoiler=[b]Speerspitze[/b]]

The TKS Siegfried and its carrier strike group would act as the tip of the spear in Operation Elseyr Shield. The nuclear powered aircraft carrier, its escorting ships and its carrier air wing had already been positioned in the north of the Westlichen Ozean in preparation for airstrikes on the Bobian homeland during Operation Elseyr Eagle. Since receiving orders from the Central Military Commission at 0200 hours on June 24th they had been moving fast towards Nestor Sikirsk. Now the aircraft carrier, guided missile cruisers, destroyers, nuclear submarines and logistics ships sat 300 kilometers off the shore, ready to act. 

Once the Kaiser had declared a state of war, the carrier strike group would move into action. J-16CJs flew off the deck along with their accompanying EK-18 electronic warfare planes and J-15E air superiority aircraft. Their job would be to suppress or destroy the island's air defenses before the strikes would begin. 

The J-16CJs, a specific variant designed for suppression of enemy air defenses or SEAD, would move in sync with the rest of the strike package. EK-18s would disrupt enemy communications, weapons systems and jam electronic signals to constantly disrupt the flow of information on the battlefield. Once the aircraft are within range, the J-16CJs launch their REG-3000 anti-radiation missiles. The missiles, which track the electronic emissions of enemy anti-air radars and batteries, lock on after launch and move to destroy with deadly accuracy. 

Falkenjagd loitering drones would also be dropped by the thousands into Nestor-Sikirskian territory. The loitering drones designed by the Kaiserreichs defense industries stay low to avoid radar detection and move until they detect radar emissions. Then they dive onto the target and explode with 15 kg of force without requiring any human in the loop authorization.[/spoiler]

[spoiler=[b]Das Inferno des Krieges[/b]]

When the anti-air of the enemy had been properly suppressed or destroyed, the CSG would begin their airstrikes. The Donnerkeil cruise missile, while subsonic, was designed to be extremely stealthy. Staying low to terrain and its design would make it extremely difficult to identify and intercept en route. When trying to intercept them near impact, the enemy forces would find these missiles deploy chaff as they reach their terminal phases, misleading radars that attempt to lock onto them. 

Around 600 of these cruise missiles would be fired in the initial barrage. The strike, timed to release the 600 at the same time would work to overwhelm air defenses that had already been struck by the REG-3000s. Each of the twin Seewolf-class nuclear submarines would release 160 Donnerkeils while the rest of the fleet launched theirs on top of launches from the mainland which sat within range. The guided munitions with their deadly accuracy would target and attempt to cripple the enemy forces. Supply depots, fuel logistics, command centers, enemy vehicles, enemy infrastructure, infantry and missile batteries would all be targets of this missile strike. 

J-15EX aircraft would take to the skies from airbases within the Kaiserreich. JDAMs, dumb bombs outfitted to become precision guided, would be dropped onto enemy positions as well. These bombs weighing in the thousands of pounds could shred into even deeply hardened enemy positions. These JDAMs would also target enemy runways and aviation fuel as the Reichswehr contested the enemy for control of the skies. Paveway JDAMS would also be dropped onto the enemies docks to prevent resupply and repairs as well as to hit vehicles at port. 

The arsenal of anti-ship and anti-coast battery hypersonics would be launched as well from the guided missile cruisers including the YJ-18 in the hundreds to suppress or destroy the enemies defenses.[/spoiler]

[spoiler=[b]Truppen am Boden[/b]]

The next step would be boots on the ground. A war cant be won with just air superiority. Once the cruise missile strike had been delivered and JDAMs had been dropped onto the enemy, the Central Military Commission decided this was the time to land onto the enemy's shores. The purpose of landing the marines or Marineinfanterie divisions would be to break through enemy lines and establish a corridor to the Enkians. Proper landing sites, reviewed by satellite intelligence, would be found near the Enkians on Nestor-Sikirsks southwest shores. Landing here would allow the Marineinfantrie to break through quickly towards the Enkians. 

On the day of the landing Marineinfantrie forces would be loaded into LCACs along with APCs to stay light. Once the beachhead had been established then heavier AAVs including the Seelowe-AAV would be brought on shore along with tanks and IFVs. Army engineers then use their armored bulldozers and mine rollers to clear any possible shore defenses and obstructions. 

All the while naval helicopters and J-16s suppress enemy fire as they drop precision guided munitions allowing the Marineinfantrie to move forward. To further confuse the defense, naval smokescreens are deployed to interfere with the enemy's line of vision. After the landing, anti-air and anti-armor are established to help repel counterattacks as naval gunfire continues to pound enemy defenses. 

To support the logistics of the Reichswehr, supply ships rapidly offload ammunition fuel and food. The engineer corps meanwhile constructs temporary airstrips and communications to facilitate future operations and the continuous flow of troops into the secure zone. By the end of Operation Seelowe, CASEVAC has been established. 

[b]The Reichswehr now stands within enemy territory and 50 miles from Enkia.[/b][/spoiler]
